propositions: Read-only derivations over git history and working tree must compute four code-health metrics: module-size distribution against a single flat hard cap, cap-change events from `.github/module-size-limit.txt` history, short-term churn summed from `git log --numstat`, and refactor-to-addition ratio from deletions/insertions

Four metric functions in `git_metrics.py` (module_size_distribution, cap_change_events, churn, refactor_to_addition_ratio) must be deterministic, read-only, and correctly handle edge cases: cap function reads from single-sourced file; churn/ratio functions return `None` when insertions are zero; cap_change_events returns empty list when no cap changes in range

Each of the four metrics must be registered into the c085 registry via context-adapter computes with lens='code_health', source='git', confidence='high', and accruing_since='2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00'

Unit tests must verify exact-value assertions: module_size_distribution counts and max_loc match fixture tree, churn totals match git log fixture, refactor_to_addition_ratio matches expected ratio or returns None, and cap_change_events returns list[dict] with old/new limits or empty list
